text:
Alex Li: Heads-up — after the CUDA driver patch rolled to 540.2 on our canary infra, we see a regression in kernel selection for transformer kernels at seq=512. p99 token latency +15% on the mlperf-like load test.

María Gómez: Ugh. Is the runtime picking a different kernel family or just different launch params?

Alex Li: Looks like the autotuner picked the 'wide-thread' matmul kernel instead of the 'tensor-core-tiling' path for blocks where seq%64==0. Profiles attached below.

Alex Li: perf output snippet:
```
# perf summary (canary h100, driver 540.2)
kernel: matmul_wide_tiled  62.3%
kernel: matmul_tensor_tile 18.1%
kernel: softmax_fused       9.6%
KV-cache hits high, but per-token p99 jumps
```

Samir Patel: Any difference on 535.x drivers?

Alex Li: Yes — on 535.86 the autotuner picks tensor_tile for the same workload and latency is stable. So behaviour correlates with driver change (probably libcudnn/cuBLAS heuristics).

María Gómez: Could be cuBLAS launching different kernels or different occupancy estimation. We saw similar once with CUDA 12.2 -> 12.3. Did we pin CUDA toolkit or only the driver?

Alex Li: We pinned toolkit to 12.3, only driver moved. Also observed increased sm_efficiency variance in Nsight logs.

Jin Koh: Quick question — is KV cache still being reused correctly or are we seeing increased KV flushes causing shorter effective seq lengths?

Alex Li: KV cache steady. This is purely kernel selection for the same effective seq. Confirmed by tracing NVTX and kernel args.

María Gómez: Short-term mitigation: add a driver-version-aware override in the kernel selector so for driver >=540 pick the old kernel family until we root-cause. That avoids full rollback.

Samir Patel: I like that as a canary rollback strategy. Steps: (1) add selector override + feature flag, (2) push canary image to 10% of traffic, (3) run mlperf-like test, (4) promote/rollback. Who can own the selector patch?

Jin Koh: I can open a small PR to add driver-version gating in selector (about ~15 LOC). It will force tensor_tile for seq>=256 when driver >=540. Patch will be behind env var KERNEL_OVERRIDE=driver_fix_540.

María Gómez: Also add a metric that counts kernel family choices and record them in the console so we can watch mixing during canary.

Alex Li: Deploy-bot: kick off a 10% canary with the selector override after PR lands.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy initiated by Alex Li — service: runtime-serving-canary — traffic: 10% — image: runtime:v2026-03-17-driversel-fix

Samir Patel: If canary still shows +10% p99, we should revert driver on the canary infra to 535 and compare. That'll tell us whether it's driver behaviour or something else. Keep rollback window <= 2h.

Jin Koh: Working on PR now, will include unit tests for autotuner decision table + a quick opt-out flag.

Alex Li: I'll prepare a rollback runbook for driver rollback (how to repro on canary, AMIs, kernel modules). Add instructions: kernel-drivers/rollback-535.sh (internal).

María Gómez: Long-term: we need a regression test that runs kernel-pick smoke-tests across driver/toolkit combinations on merge to main. Add to perf CI matrix.

Alex Li: Agreed. Also add nsight traces retention for 48h for any canary that surfaces >5% p99 regression.

Samir Patel: Tagging infra: @María @Jin please coordinate on PR + canary tonight. If we see correctness issues, abort immediate. :thumbsup:

Jin Koh: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/runtime/pulls/1427 — includes env var and selector metrics.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy results (1h): traffic 10% — p99 delta: +0.5% (within noise), kernel family counts: tensor_tile 82%, matmul_wide_tiled 15%, unknown 3% — no user impact detected.

Alex Li: Good initial signal. I'll run full mlperf pass overnight and post results. If we see anything >3% we'll revert driver or increase override coverage.

María Gómez: Thanks team. Later we should also file a bug with NVIDIA/driver team with minimal repro (small kernel-launch cassette + occupancy numbers).

Samir Patel: Added to tracking ticket: PERF-8812.

Alex Li: Night crew — please watch canary dashboards and alert if p99 > baseline + 5%.

María Gómez: :eyes:

Jin Koh: Will follow up tomorrow with final PR review and CI results.

Alex Li: Thanks all.
